profile.headline: Software Engineer at CarGurus
profile.summary: Software engineer with 6 years of experience in software development with various languages like Java, JavaScript, Python, and C++. Talented in catching details in problems with a critical mindset and welcomes any chance to try new popular tools out there. I come with experience working from diverse company environments, from a giant tech company to a fresh startup in finance, to play roles in various projects, and you’ll find me fitting easily into rather unusual surroundings while bringing creative perspectives on issues.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Promoted to Senior Software Engineer on Oct. 2020.
• Develop, maintain, and deploy the series of applications, mainly in Python, in Shorelight Live Lecture system that allows international students to take US university credited classes remotely by connecting physical studios in the US and physical classrooms offshore.
• Implemented the HomeStudio to individual students’ computers model for the Shorelight Live Lecture system as the Pandemic starts to allow the users to use our service without going outside their home.
• Update and maintain the IFD portal from both frontend sides using React and backend side using Java Spring.
• Took charge of setting up a new Spring Boot microservice backend from scratch for additional features going into the IFD portal.
• Currently working on setting up a new frontend instance using React w/ Typescript as an effort to split the monolithic structure of IFD.
• Actively participate in meetings related to demo, planning, and security as a senior member of the team.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Primary work of developing tools and scripts done in Python and the proprietary languages of TPRV’s portfolio system, Front Arena.
•	Created loaders for importing and storing data from Bloomberg API and files from SFTP sites or emails, and export modules for sending trade and security data to the company’s settlement agents.
•	Took charge of parsing and processing FIX messages from FXGO, VCON, and TT servers to support electronic trading in Front Arena.
•	Supported the front & middle offices and the risk manager with technical advices and active involvement to their tasks on daily basis.
•	Managed company-wide software updates and various Front Arena services setups, and helped IT infrastructure maintenance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Run automated benchmark tests on each internal ZFS supported OSs, AK & Solaris, release and investigate on performance regressions utilizing the collected system analytic data.
•	Set up 5 new testing environments, consisting of Solaris clients and ZFS storage appliances, to extend performance benchmark testing capacity of the team.
•	Implemented data replication performance test automation utilizing the AutoInstall server in Broomfield, CO.
•	Charged with creating workflow scripts that update the kernel parameters in running ZFS storage appliances in the team.

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Defined, developed, and executed automation tests to perform regression test for the core Android app of the NCR’s Hospitality division using Appium framework.
•	Developed and executed test plans and test cases for the various Android app features developed during each sprint cycles using QA best practices and standards and updated the regression script for the core Android app of the NCR’s Hospitality division accordingly.
•	Experienced working in agile SDLC environment and actively participated team meetings such as daily stand-up, grooming, sprint-demo, retrospect, sprint-planning, and so on.

positions.title: POS (Point-Of-Sale) System Technician
positions.description:
•	Managed over 25 new installations and transferred data between DBs, each earning $20k~45k in revenue, in various states, such as GA, AL, TN, SC, and FL, in one year.
•	Provided on-site and remote customer service and maintenance with high customer satisfaction.
•	Oversaw and trained all new technicians employed in Georgia region.
